# 7. Pacific Twin Suns Meeting (Celestial Empire + Nova Elysia)
oe_cel3.7 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel3.7.title
	desc = oe_cel3.7.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel3_twin_suns_pacific.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_pacific_accord_done value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
					NOT = { this = root }
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_cel3_elysia_partner
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.7.a
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_pacific_meridian_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_elysia_partner }
			scope:oe_cel3_elysia_partner = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_pacific_meridian_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.7.b
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		add_gold = 200
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_silver_porcelain_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = capital }
			capital = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = market }
					market = {
						add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cel3_dem_tribute_americas scale = 1.2 months = 60 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_elysia_partner }
			scope:oe_cel3_elysia_partner = {
				add_gold = 200
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_silver_porcelain_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
				if = {
					limit = { exists = capital }
					capital = {
						if = {
							limit = { exists = market }
							market = {
								add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cel3_dem_tribute_asia scale = 1.2 months = 60 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.7.c
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
		add_prestige = 15
		add_navy_tradition = 10
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_pacific_rivalry_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_elysia_partner }
			scope:oe_cel3_elysia_partner = {
				add_prestige = 15
				add_navy_tradition = 10
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_pacific_rivalry_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 8. Indian Ocean Twin Phoenixes Meeting (Celestial Empire + BYZ / ROM / Nostos Nova Elysia)
oe_cel3.8 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel3.8.title
	desc = oe_cel3.8.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel3_twin_suns_pacific.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_indian_accord_done value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_roman_io_partner = yes } }
			c:ROM = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_io_partner }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_roman_io_partner = yes } }
			c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_io_partner }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared }
			random_country = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_roman_io_partner = yes }
				save_scope_as = oe_cel3_io_partner
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.8.a
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
		add_prestige = 12
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_io_demarcation_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_io_partner }
			scope:oe_cel3_io_partner = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_io_demarcation_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.8.b
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		add_prestige = 15
		add_navy_tradition = 10
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_io_spice_contest_mod years = 20 mode = replace }

			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_io_partner }

				add_navy_tradition = 10
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_io_spice_contest_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 9. Eurasian Concert: Twin Suns Co-Governance Charter (soft-linked to v12.0 oe_con_)
oe_cel3.9 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel3.9.title
	desc = oe_cel3.9.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel3_twin_suns_pacific.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_concert_accord_done value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_concert_western_partner = yes } }
			c:ROM = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_concert_partner }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_concert_western_partner = yes } }
			c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_concert_partner }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
			random_country = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_concert_western_partner = yes }
				save_scope_as = oe_cel3_concert_partner
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.9.a
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		add_prestige = 20
		change_celestial_authority = { value = 4 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_twin_suns_charter_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_con_resolutions_passed }
			add_prestige = 15
			change_celestial_authority = { value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_concert_partner }
			scope:oe_cel3_concert_partner = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_twin_suns_charter_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.9.b
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		add_prestige = 25
		change_celestial_authority = { value = 5 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_celestial_primacy_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	}
}

# 90. Celestial Empire 3.0 Live Readout Panel (Read-Only Telemetry via ScriptValue)
oe_cel3.90 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel3.90.title
	desc = {
		desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_header
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes }
				desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_track_yuan
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = yes }
				desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_track_ming
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = yes }
				desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_track_qing
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes }
				desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_track_alt
			}
			desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_not_emperor
		}
		desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_stats
		desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_tribute
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
				desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_concert_on
			}
			desc = oe_cel3.90.desc_concert_off
		}
	}
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel3_grand_duhu_seal.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.90.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3.90.b
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes
		oe_cel3_refresh_all_duhu_names = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.90
	}
}
